name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/frozen-byte-array-modification-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: value:cloneWithType; value:fromJsonWithType; value:toString and value:toBalString.
reason: The asserted panic follows modification of a byte array obtained through a.cloneReadOnly(). cloneReadOnly is absent from both the supported lang.value functions and the supported langlib method-call list, so the test requires an unsupported operation essential to establishing the frozen array.
test_design_notes: The assignment uses index 5 on an initial three-element array; the sole @panic marker does not distinguish frozen-update failure from other possible failures.
